const wrongSeverityByQuestion=[{A:'medium',B:'mild',D:'severe'},{B:'mild',C:'medium',D:'severe'},{A:'mild',B:'medium',C:'severe'},{C:'mild',D:'medium',A:'severe'},{D:'mild',A:'medium',B:'severe'}];

// Warm up only the four possible reaction videos for the current question.

const preloadHost=document.createElement('div');

document.body.appendChild(preloadHost);
const preloadFrames=new Map();
const memeLevels=['correct','mild','medium','severe'];
function tikTokPlayerUrl(meme,preload){
 // Prepare embeds muted by the documented mute command, but keep force_muted=0 so they can be unmuted after selection.
 const params=preload
  ?'?autoplay=0&force_muted=0&loop=0&controls=0&progress_bar=0&play_button=0&volume_control=0&fullscreen_button=0&timestamp=0&description=0&music_info=0&rel=0&native_context_menu=0'
  :'?autoplay=1&force_muted=0&loop=0&controls=0&progress_bar=0&play_button=0&volume_control=0&fullscreen_button=0&timestamp=0&description=0&music_info=0&rel=0&native_context_menu=0';
 return 'https://www.tiktok.com/player/v1/'+meme.id+params;
}
function memeForQuestionChoice(qIndex,choice){
 const answer=answers[qIndex]?.s.querySelector('.answer-letter');
 const correct=(answer?.textContent||'').replace(/[^A-D]/g,'').slice(-1);
 const right=choice===correct;
 const level=right?'correct':(wrongSeverityByQuestion[qIndex]?.[choice]||'severe');
 return memePool[level]?.[qIndex]||null;
}
function refreshQuestionVideoReadiness(qIndex){
 const q=questions[qIndex];if(!q)return;
 const candidates=memeLevels.map(level=>memePool[level]?.[qIndex]).filter(Boolean);
 let warmed=0,failed=0;
 // Loading a reaction clip must never make an answer unselectable.
 q.s.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach(button=>{button.disabled=false});
 candidates.forEach(meme=>{
  const frame=preloadFrames.get(meme.id);
  if(frame?.dataset.warmed==='1')warmed++;
  if(frame?.dataset.failed==='1')failed++;
 });
 const foot=q.s.querySelector('.qfoot');
 if(foot){
  if(warmed===candidates.length)foot.textContent='VIDEO ĐÃ CHUẨN BỊ  ·  CHỌN ĐÁP ÁN';
  else if(failed)foot.textContent='ĐANG TẢI DỰ PHÒNG VIDEO  ·  BẠN VẪN CÓ THỂ CHỌN';
  else foot.textContent='VIDEO ĐANG ĐƯỢC CHUẨN BỊ NỀN  ·  BẠN CÓ THỂ CHỌN NGAY';
 }
}
const pendingPreloads=new Map();
const activePreloads=new Set();
const MAX_CONCURRENT_PRELOADS=2;
function releasePreloadSlot(frame){
 const id=frame?.dataset?.memeId;
 if(!id)return;
 if(frame._warmupTimer){clearTimeout(frame._warmupTimer);frame._warmupTimer=null}
 activePreloads.delete(id);
 pumpQuestionVideoPreloads();
}
function pumpQuestionVideoPreloads(){
 while(activePreloads.size<MAX_CONCURRENT_PRELOADS&&pendingPreloads.size){
  const first=pendingPreloads.entries().next().value;
  if(!first)break;
  const [id,job]=first;
  pendingPreloads.delete(id);
  if(preloadFrames.get(id)!==job.frame||job.frame.dataset.queued!=='1')continue;
  activePreloads.add(id);
  job.frame.dataset.queued='0';
  job.frame.dataset.preloading='1';
  job.frame.src=tikTokPlayerUrl(job.meme,true);
  job.frame._warmupTimer=setTimeout(()=>{
   if(job.frame.dataset.warmed!=='1'&&job.frame.dataset.failed!=='1'&&job.frame.dataset.autoplayBlocked!=='1'){
    if(job.frame.dataset.ready==='1')job.frame.dataset.autoplayBlocked='1';
    else job.frame.dataset.failed='1';
   }
   refreshQuestionVideoReadiness(job.qIndex);
   releasePreloadSlot(job.frame);
  },12000);
 }
}
function preloadQuestionVideos(qIndex){
 if(qIndex<0||qIndex>=questions.length)return;
 const candidates=memeLevels.map(level=>memePool[level]?.[qIndex]).filter(Boolean);
 const wanted=new Set(candidates.map(m=>m.id));
 for(const [id,frame] of preloadFrames){
  if(!wanted.has(id)&&frame!==player){
   pendingPreloads.delete(id);
   if(activePreloads.delete(id)&&frame._warmupTimer){clearTimeout(frame._warmupTimer);frame._warmupTimer=null}
   frame.src='about:blank';frame.remove();preloadFrames.delete(id);
  }
 }
 candidates.forEach(meme=>{
  if(preloadFrames.has(meme.id))return;
  const frame=document.createElement('iframe');
  frame.title='Prepared reaction video';
  frame.loading='eager';
  frame.referrerPolicy='strict-origin-when-cross-origin';
  frame.setAttribute('allow','autoplay; encrypted-media; fullscreen; picture-in-picture; web-share');
  frame.dataset.memeId=meme.id;
  frame.dataset.questionIndex=String(qIndex);
  frame.dataset.preload='1';
  frame.dataset.ready='0';
  frame.dataset.warmed='0';
  frame.dataset.queued='1';
  frame.style.cssText='position:absolute;left:-10000px;top:0;width:320px;height:568px;border:0;opacity:0;pointer-events:none';
  preloadHost.appendChild(frame);
  preloadFrames.set(meme.id,frame);
  pendingPreloads.set(meme.id,{meme,qIndex,frame});
 });
 pumpQuestionVideoPreloads();
 refreshQuestionVideoReadiness(qIndex);
}
function parkActivePlayer(){
 if(player!==basePlayer){
  player.style.cssText='position:absolute;left:-10000px;top:0;width:320px;height:568px;border:0;opacity:0;pointer-events:none';
  player.dataset.preload='1';
  preloadHost.appendChild(player);
  player=basePlayer;
 }
 basePlayer.style.display='';
}
let chosenMeme=null,memeStarted=false,memeFinished=false,memeStartGuard=null,memeCutoff=null;

function startRiverAudio(){
 if(!riverSound)return;
 riverSound.volume=.34;
 if(!riverSound.paused){if(audioHint)audioHint.hidden=true;return}
 try{
  const attempt=riverSound.play();
  if(attempt&&typeof attempt.then==='function'){
   attempt.then(()=>{if(audioHint)audioHint.hidden=true;})
    .catch(()=>{if(audioHint&&current===0)audioHint.hidden=false;});
  }else if(audioHint){audioHint.hidden=true}
 }catch(e){if(audioHint&&current===0)audioHint.hidden=false}
}
function retryRiverAudioFromGesture(){if(current===0&&riverSound&&riverSound.paused)startRiverAudio()}
document.addEventListener('pointerdown',retryRiverAudioFromGesture,{passive:true});
document.addEventListener('keydown',retryRiverAudioFromGesture);
function stopTimer(){if(timer){clearInterval(timer);timer=null}}
function ensureAudio(){try{const C=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!C)return null;if(!audioCtx)audioCtx=new C();if(audioCtx.state==='suspended')audioCtx.resume();return audioCtx}catch(e){return null}}
function tone(freq=880,duration=.11,vol=.08){const c=ensureAudio();if(!c)return;try{const o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.type='sine';o.frequency.value=freq;g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol,c.currentTime);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,c.currentTime+duration);o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+duration)}catch(e){}}
function feedbackSound(right){ensureAudio();if(right){[523,659,784,1047].forEach((f,i)=>setTimeout(()=>tone(f,.20,.105),i*95))}else{[520,390,260].forEach((f,i)=>setTimeout(()=>tone(f,.24,.12),i*120))}}
function startTimer(s){
 stopTimer();remaining=15;
 const time=s.querySelector('.time'),fill=s.querySelector('.timerline b');
 if(time)time.textContent='15';
 if(fill){
  fill.style.transition='none';fill.style.transform='scaleX(1)';
  requestAnimationFrame(()=>{fill.style.transition='transform 15s linear';fill.style.transform='scaleX(0)'});
 }
 timer=setInterval(()=>{
  remaining=Math.max(0,remaining-1);
  if(time)time.textContent=String(remaining).padStart(2,'0');
  if(remaining<=5&&remaining>0)tone(remaining<=2?1046:880,.09,remaining<=2?.11:.075);
  if(remaining===0){
   tone(660,.18,.13);setTimeout(()=>tone(520,.22,.12),180);
   stopTimer();
   s.dataset.answered='1';
   s.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach(button=>{button.disabled=true});
   const qIndex=questions.findIndex(q=>q.s===s);
   const answer=answers[qIndex];
   if(answer)showTimeoutMeme(qIndex,answer.i,'timeout');
  }
 },1000);
}
function pausePlayer(){try{if(player.contentWindow)player.contentWindow.postMessage({type:'pause','x-tiktok-player':true},'*')}catch(e){}}
function postToPlayer(type,value){try{if(player.contentWindow){const msg={type,'x-tiktok-player':true};if(value!==undefined)msg.value=value;player.contentWindow.postMessage(msg,'*')}}catch(e){}}
function hideMeme(){
 if(memeFallback){clearTimeout(memeFallback);memeFallback=null}
 pausePlayer();
 stage.classList.remove('active');
 stage.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
 const timeoutPanel=document.getElementById('timeout-meme');
 if(timeoutPanel){timeoutPanel.classList.remove('active');timeoutPanel.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true')}
 parkActivePlayer();
 basePlayer.removeAttribute('src');
 playerReady=false;
 basePlayer.style.visibility='visible';
}
function show(n){
 stopTimer();hideMeme();
 current=Math.max(0,Math.min(slides.length-1,n));
 slides.forEach((s,j)=>s.classList.toggle('active',j===current));
 if(count)count.textContent=String(current+1).padStart(2,'0')+' / '+String(slides.length).padStart(2,'0');
 if(bar)bar.style.width=((current+1)/slides.length*100)+'%';
 const s=slides[current];
 if(s.dataset.kind==='question'){
  const qIndex=questions.findIndex(q=>q.i===current);
  s.dataset.answered='0';
  s.dataset.timerStarted='1';
  s.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach(o=>{o.disabled=false;o.classList.remove('is-picked')});
  preloadQuestionVideos(qIndex);
  refreshQuestionVideoReadiness(qIndex);
  startTimer(s);
 }else if(s.dataset.kind==='answer'){
  preloadQuestionVideos(answers.findIndex(a=>a.i===current)+1);
 }
 if(s.dataset.kind==='cover'){
  const v=s.querySelector('video');
  if(v){v.currentTime=0;v.play().catch(()=>{})}
  if(riverSound){riverSound.currentTime=0;startRiverAudio()}
  preloadQuestionVideos(0);
 }else if(riverSound){
  riverSound.pause();riverSound.currentTime=0;
  if(audioHint)audioHint.hidden=true;
 }
}
function chooseOption(q,button){
 if(q.s.dataset.answered==='1')return;
 q.s.dataset.answered='1';
 stopTimer();ensureAudio();
 const options=[...q.s.querySelectorAll('.option')];
 options.forEach(o=>{o.disabled=true;o.classList.remove('is-picked')});
 button.classList.add('is-picked');
 selectedChoice=button.dataset.choice||'';
 const qIndex=questions.indexOf(q);
 const a=answers[qIndex];if(!a)return;
 answerIndex=a.i;
 const answerEl=a.s.querySelector('.answer-letter');
 const correct=(answerEl?.textContent||'').replace(/[^A-D]/g,'').slice(-1);
 const right=selectedChoice===correct;
 const level=right?'correct':(wrongSeverityByQuestion[qIndex]?.[selectedChoice]||'severe');
 currentLevel=level;
 chosenMeme=memePool[level][qIndex];
 playMeme(chosenMeme,a.i,right,selectedChoice,correct,level);
}
const memeLevelLabels={correct:'CHÍNH XÁC  ·  CHỐT ĐÁP ÁN',mild:'SAI NHẸ  ·  LỆCH MỘT CHI TIẾT',medium:'SAI VỪA  ·  NHẦM MỘT MỐI QUAN HỆ',severe:'SAI XA  ·  QUAY LẠI CĂN CỨ'};
const timeoutMemes=[
 {kind:'slow',emoji:'⏳',headline:'Não đang tải… 99%',caption:'Chậm một nhịp để nối nguyên khí thịnh – suy.'},
 {kind:'brain',emoji:'🧠',headline:'Ba tầng ý cùng chạy!',caption:'Bồi dưỡng · tuyển chọn · vun trồng — não cần thêm băng thông.'},
 {kind:'slow',emoji:'🐢',headline:'Ý tưởng đến hơi muộn…',caption:'Đang xếp lại chuỗi khoa danh, tước trật và lưu danh.'},
 {kind:'brain',emoji:'🌀',headline:'Mê cung suy luận!',caption:'Dẫn chứng, lời phỏng đoán và dụng ý giáo huấn đang xoắn vào nhau.'},
 {kind:'brain',emoji:'🔄',headline:'Hệ thống tư duy quá tải!',caption:'Tư cách · trách nhiệm · cống hiến — cần khởi động lại.'}
];
function ensureTimeoutPanel(){
 let panel=document.getElementById('timeout-meme');
 if(!panel){
  panel=document.createElement('div');
  panel.id='timeout-meme';
  panel.setAttribute('aria-live','polite');
  panel.setAttribute('aria-atomic','true');
  stage.appendChild(panel);
 }
 return panel;
}
function finishTimeoutMeme(answerSlideIndex,reason){
 stopPlayerTimers();
 hideMeme();
 const target=slides[answerSlideIndex];if(!target)return;
 const letter=(target.querySelector('.answer-letter')?.textContent||'').replace(/[^A-D]/g,'').slice(-1);
 const banner=target.querySelector('.response-result');
 if(banner){
  banner.textContent=reason==='timeout'?'HẾT THỜI GIAN  ·  ĐÁP ÁN ĐÚNG '+letter:'VIDEO CHƯA PHÁT ĐƯỢC  ·  ĐÁP ÁN ĐÚNG '+letter;
  banner.classList.remove('is-wrong');
 }
 show(answerSlideIndex);
}
function showTimeoutMeme(qIndex,answerSlideIndex,reason='timeout'){
 stopPlayerTimers();
 pausePlayer();
 hideMeme();
 const data=timeoutMemes[qIndex]||timeoutMemes[0];
 const panel=ensureTimeoutPanel();
 panel.className='timeout-meme '+data.kind+' active';
 panel.innerHTML='<div class="timeout-card"><div class="timeout-kicker">'+(reason==='timeout'?'HẾT THỜI GIAN':'VIDEO ĐANG TẢI CHẬM')+'</div><div class="timeout-emoji">'+data.emoji+'</div><div class="timeout-headline">'+data.headline+'</div><div class="timeout-caption">'+data.caption+'</div><div class="timeout-meter"><span></span></div></div>';
 basePlayer.style.display='none';
 stage.classList.add('active');
 stage.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
 memeFinished=true;
 memeFallback=setTimeout(()=>finishTimeoutMeme(answerSlideIndex,reason),reason==='video'?1600:4200);
}
function playMeme(meme,answerSlideIndex,right,choice,correct,level){
 stopPlayerTimers();
 if(memeReaction)memeReaction.textContent=memeLevelLabels[level]||memeLevelLabels.severe;
 if(memeCaption)memeCaption.textContent=meme.caption||'Phản ứng cho lựa chọn này';
 if(memeSource)memeSource.textContent='VIDEO TIKTOK NGẮN  ·  '+(meme.creator||'');
 memeStarted=false;memeFinished=false;
 const qIndex=answers.findIndex(a=>a.i===answerSlideIndex);
 let cached=preloadFrames.get(meme.id);
 if(cached&&cached.dataset.failed==='1'){
  cached.src='about:blank';cached.remove();preloadFrames.delete(meme.id);cached=null;
 }
 // Once the player selected by the user is known, stop fetching the three unused reactions.
 for(const [id,frame] of preloadFrames){
  if(id!==meme.id&&frame!==player){
   pendingPreloads.delete(id);
   if(activePreloads.delete(id)&&frame._warmupTimer){clearTimeout(frame._warmupTimer);frame._warmupTimer=null}
   frame.src='about:blank';frame.remove();preloadFrames.delete(id);
  }
 }
 if(cached){
  pendingPreloads.delete(meme.id);
  releasePreloadSlot(cached);
  parkActivePlayer();
  basePlayer.style.display='none';
  player=cached;
  player.dataset.preload='0';
  stage.insertBefore(player,document.getElementById('meme-overlay'));
  player.style.cssText='width:100vw;height:100vh;border:0;background:#050302;display:block;visibility:hidden';
  playerReady=player.dataset.ready==='1';
  const hasPlayerSource=!!player.getAttribute('src')&&player.getAttribute('src')!=='about:blank';
  if(!hasPlayerSource){
   player.dataset.queued='0';
   player.src=tikTokPlayerUrl(meme,false);
  }
 }else{
  parkActivePlayer();
  player=basePlayer;
  basePlayer.style.display='';
  playerReady=false;
 }
 stage.classList.add('active');stage.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
 const timeoutPanel=document.getElementById('timeout-meme');
 if(timeoutPanel)timeoutPanel.classList.remove('active');
 player.dataset.answer=String(answerSlideIndex);
 player.dataset.right=right?'1':'0';
 player.dataset.choice=choice;player.dataset.correct=correct;
 player.dataset.level=level;player.dataset.clip=String(meme.clip||3.3);
 if(cached){
  // A warmed player can start immediately; a queued player loads after this user gesture.
  if(player.getAttribute('src')&&player.getAttribute('src')!=='about:blank'){
   postToPlayer('unMute');
   postToPlayer('play');
  }
 }else{
  // A cache miss is loaded only after the user's click, with autoplay enabled.
  player.src=tikTokPlayerUrl(meme,false);
 }
 memeStartGuard=setTimeout(()=>{if(!memeStarted&&!memeFinished){postToPlayer('unMute');postToPlayer('play')}},350);
 memeFallback=setTimeout(()=>{
  if(memeFinished)return;
  if(!memeStarted)showTimeoutMeme(qIndex,answerSlideIndex,'video');
  else revealAnswer(answerSlideIndex,right,choice,correct,level);
 },4500);
}
function stopPlayerTimers(){
 if(memeFallback){clearTimeout(memeFallback);memeFallback=null}
 if(memeStartGuard){clearTimeout(memeStartGuard);memeStartGuard=null}
 if(memeCutoff){clearTimeout(memeCutoff);memeCutoff=null}
}
function feedbackSound(right,level){
 ensureAudio();
 if(right){[523,659,784,1047].forEach((f,i)=>setTimeout(()=>tone(f,.19,.11),i*105));return}
 const patterns={mild:[660,587],medium:[587,440,370],severe:[520,392,262,196]};
 (patterns[level]||patterns.severe).forEach((f,i)=>setTimeout(()=>tone(f,.20,level==='severe'?.12:.09),i*115));
}
function revealAnswer(idx,right,choice,correct,level){
 if(memeFinished)return;
 memeFinished=true;stopPlayerTimers();
 try{postToPlayer('pause')}catch(e){}
 feedbackSound(right,level||player.dataset.level||'severe');
 setTimeout(()=>{
  hideMeme();
  const target=slides[idx];if(!target)return;
  const banner=target.querySelector('.response-result');
  if(banner){banner.textContent=right?'CHÍNH XÁC  ·  BẠN ĐÃ CHỌN '+choice:'CHƯA CHÍNH XÁC  ·  BẠN ĐÃ CHỌN '+choice;banner.classList.toggle('is-wrong',!right)}
  show(idx);
 },760);
}
window.addEventListener('message',e=>{
 if(!e.origin.includes('tiktok.com'))return;
 let d=e.data;if(typeof d==='string'){try{d=JSON.parse(d)}catch(_){return}}
 if(!d||typeof d!=='object')return;
 const sourceFrame=[...preloadFrames.values()].find(frame=>frame.contentWindow===e.source);
 if(sourceFrame&&e.source!==player.contentWindow){
  const preloadQ=Number(sourceFrame.dataset.questionIndex);
  if(d.type==='onPlayerReady'){
   sourceFrame.dataset.ready='1';
   // TikTok's documented mute command allows a silent warm-up without locking the player muted.
   try{
    sourceFrame.contentWindow.postMessage({type:'mute','x-tiktok-player':true},'*');
    setTimeout(()=>sourceFrame.contentWindow?.postMessage({type:'play','x-tiktok-player':true},'*'),0);
   }catch(_){}
   refreshQuestionVideoReadiness(preloadQ);
  }
  if(d.type==='onStateChange'&&Number(d.value)===1){
   sourceFrame.dataset.warmed='1';
   sourceFrame.contentWindow.postMessage({type:'pause','x-tiktok-player':true},'*');
   refreshQuestionVideoReadiness(preloadQ);
   releasePreloadSlot(sourceFrame);
  }
  if(d.type==='onPlayerError'||d.type==='onError'){
   const info=d.value&&typeof d.value==='object'?d.value:{};
   const code=Number(info.errorCode??d.errorCode??d.value);
   if(sourceFrame._warmupTimer){clearTimeout(sourceFrame._warmupTimer);sourceFrame._warmupTimer=null}
   if(code===3002){
    // Autoplay policy error is recoverable after the user selects an answer.
    sourceFrame.dataset.ready='1';
    sourceFrame.dataset.autoplayBlocked='1';
   }else{
    sourceFrame.dataset.failed='1';
   }
   refreshQuestionVideoReadiness(preloadQ);
   releasePreloadSlot(sourceFrame);
  }
  return;
 }
 if(e.source!==player.contentWindow)return;
 const idx=Number(player.dataset.answer),right=player.dataset.right==='1',choice=player.dataset.choice,correct=player.dataset.correct,level=player.dataset.level||'severe';
 if(d.type==='onPlayerReady'){
  playerReady=true;player.dataset.ready='1';
  postToPlayer('unMute');
  postToPlayer('play');
 }
 if(d.type==='onStateChange'){
  const state=Number(d.value);
  if(state===1&&!memeStarted){
   player.style.visibility='visible';
   memeStarted=true;
   if(memeStartGuard){clearTimeout(memeStartGuard);memeStartGuard=null}
   if(memeFallback){clearTimeout(memeFallback);memeFallback=null}
   // Once playback has begun, let the clip's own cutoff control the duration.
   memeCutoff=setTimeout(()=>{postToPlayer('pause');revealAnswer(idx,right,choice,correct,level)},Math.max(2600,(Number(player.dataset.clip)||3.3)*1000+900));
  }
  if(state===0)revealAnswer(idx,right,choice,correct,level);
 }
 if(d.type==='onCurrentTime'){
  const v=d.value||{};const currentTime=Number(v.currentTime);
  if(Number.isFinite(currentTime)&&memeStarted&&currentTime>=((Number(player.dataset.clip)||3.3)+.5)){
   postToPlayer('pause');revealAnswer(idx,right,choice,correct,level);
  }
 }
 if(d.type==='onPlayerError'||d.type==='onError'){
  const info=d.value&&typeof d.value==='object'?d.value:{};
  const code=Number(info.errorCode??d.errorCode??d.value);
  const qIndex=answers.findIndex(a=>a.i===idx);
  if(code===3002){
   // Retry through the visible player after the user gesture; the click path has already requested play.
   postToPlayer('unMute');postToPlayer('play');
  }else{
   showTimeoutMeme(qIndex,idx,'video');
  }
 }
});
questions.forEach(q=>q.s.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>chooseOption(q,btn))));
function navigateBackToCanva(){
 // Open the original design in Canva's full-screen presentation route, on slide 14.
 const target='https://www.canva.com/design/DAHZrugfPaA/IJksAWSk4X0Hy_v-o8St8Q/present?page=14';
 try{
  if(window.opener&&!window.opener.closed){
   window.opener.location.replace(target);
   window.close();
   return;
  }
 }catch(e){}
 window.location.replace(target);
}
function next(){
 const s=slides[current];
 if(s.dataset.kind==='question')return;
 if(s.dataset.kind==='closing'){navigateBackToCanva();return;}
 if(s.dataset.kind==='answer'){
  const qi=answers.findIndex(a=>a.i===current);
  if(qi>=0&&qi+1<questions.length){show(questions[qi+1].i);return}
 }
 show(current+1);
}
const closingSlide=document.querySelector('.slide[data-kind="closing"]');
if(closingSlide){
 closingSlide.style.cursor='pointer';
 closingSlide.setAttribute('aria-label','Bấm vào slide kết thúc để quay lại bài trình chiếu Canva');
 closingSlide.addEventListener('click',function(event){
  if(event.target.closest('.replay'))return;
  navigateBackToCanva();
 });
}
function prev(){if(current<=0)return;const s=slides[current];if(s.dataset.kind==='answer'){const qi=answers.findIndex(a=>a.i===current);if(qi>=0){show(questions[qi].i);return}}show(current-1)}
slides.forEach(slide=>{
 const kind=slide.dataset.kind;
 if(kind==='cover'||kind==='answer'){
  slide.addEventListener('click',event=>{
   if(event.target.closest('button,a,iframe,video'))return;
   next();
  });
 }
});
document.getElementById('prev')?.addEventListener('click',prev);document.getElementById('next')?.addEventListener('click',next);document.getElementById('home')?.addEventListener('click',()=>show(0));document.getElementById('fs')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!document.fullscreenElement)document.documentElement.requestFullscreen?.();else document.exitFullscreen?.()});
const startButton=document.querySelector('.cover .start');
function beginPresentation(event){
 if(event){event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();}
 ensureAudio();
 if(riverSound){riverSound.currentTime=0;startRiverAudio()}
 if(introTimer){clearTimeout(introTimer);introTimer=null}
 show(questions[0]?.i??1);
 if(!document.fullscreenElement){
  const fullscreenRequest=document.documentElement.requestFullscreen?.();
  if(fullscreenRequest&&typeof fullscreenRequest.catch==='function')fullscreenRequest.catch(()=>{});
 }
}
if(startButton){
 startButton.type='button';
 startButton.disabled=false;
 startButton.style.position='relative';
 startButton.style.zIndex='1001';
 startButton.style.pointerEvents='auto';
 startButton.addEventListener('click',beginPresentation);
}
document.querySelector('.replay')?.addEventListener('click',()=>show(0));
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(['ArrowRight','PageDown',' '].includes(e.key)){e.preventDefault();next()}else if(['ArrowLeft','PageUp'].includes(e.key)){e.preventDefault();prev()}else if(e.key.toLowerCase()==='f'){if(!document.fullscreenElement)document.documentElement.requestFullscreen?.();else document.exitFullscreen?.()}else if(e.key==='Home')show(0);else if(e.key==='End')show(slides.length-1)});
show(0);
})();</script></body></html>
